## Bearer

PaceCalculator — core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sensor/PaceCalculator.kt

## Trigger

Computing the segment or smoothed pace in MainRacePageViewModel.computeState,
via PaceCalculator.segmentPace and PaceCalculator.smoothedPace, when the
profile's correction factor or the resulting speed is zero or negative —
observed (both are called on every recompute, from the watch's own race
screen).

## Today

PaceCalculator.segmentPace and PaceCalculator.smoothedPace multiply a raw
speed by `correctionFactor` with no check on its sign, on it being zero, or
on the resulting `speedMetersPerSecond` being zero or negative, and always
wrap the result in `PaceResult.Value`.

MainRacePageViewModel.computeState divides `1000.0 / paceResult.speedMetersPerSecond`
to build the displayed pace whenever `paceResult` is a `PaceResult.Value`
(line 177), with no check that the divisor is positive. A zero or negative
speed drives the division to `Infinity`/`-Infinity`, and `.roundToLong()`
turns that into `Long.MAX_VALUE`/`Long.MIN_VALUE`.

LapDeltaCalculator.compute divides `expectedDistanceM / pace.speedMetersPerSecond`
the same way once `pace` is a `PaceResult.Value` (line 33), reaching the same
`Infinity`/`Long.MAX_VALUE` outcome, and then floors the result:
`projectedMs = maxOf(projectedMsRaw, elapsedInSegmentMs)` (line 34) turns a
negative `projectedMsRaw` — the case a negative speed produces — into
`elapsedInSegmentMs`, masking the invalid speed as a normal, merely-slow
projection instead of exposing it.

TrendArrowCalculator.determine divides `(smoothed.speedMetersPerSecond - segmentSpeed) / segmentSpeed`
once both are `PaceResult.Value` (line 22). When `segmentSpeed` is zero and
`smoothed.speedMetersPerSecond` is also zero, the ratio is `NaN`. `abs(NaN) <= THRESHOLD_RATIO`
and `NaN > 0` both evaluate to `false`, so the `when` falls through to
`else -> TrendArrow.Down` (line 27) — a downward arrow for a pace that was
never computed.

## Expected

PaceCalculator.segmentPace and PaceCalculator.smoothedPace return
`PaceResult.Fallback` — the value they already return for their other
noise cases — when `correctionFactor` is zero or negative, or when the
computed `speedMetersPerSecond` is zero or negative, instead of wrapping it
in `PaceResult.Value`.

MainRacePageViewModel.computeState and TrendArrowCalculator.determine
already gate their division on `paceResult is PaceResult.Value` /
`smoothed/segment is PaceResult.Value` (lines 174 and 19 respectively);
once PaceCalculator never emits a `Value` carrying a zero or negative
speed, neither divides by zero nor receives a negative divisor, and no
further change is needed at either site.

LapDeltaCalculator.compute does not rely solely on that upstream guarantee:
when `pace.speedMetersPerSecond` is zero or negative it returns
`LapDeltaResult.Fallback` — the value it already returns when `pace` is not
a `PaceResult.Value` — instead of computing `projectedMsRaw` and flooring
it through `maxOf(projectedMsRaw, elapsedInSegmentMs)`, which today would
silently turn a negative projection into the elapsed time rather than
surfacing it as invalid.
